entities.summary: Sheldon "Shelly" Manne was an American jazz drummer. Most frequently associated with West Coast jazz, he was known for his versatility and also played in a number of other styles, including Dixieland, swing, bebop, avant-garde jazz, and later fusion. He also contributed to the musical background of hundreds of Hollywood films and television programs. Shelly Manne was a composers & musicians from New York City (1920-06-11, New York City–1984-09-26). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
